maddeler.e:
استشببت (form X)
# اِسْتَشْبَبْتُ (istašbabtu) /is.taʃ.bab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَشَبَّ (istašabba)
# اِسْتَشْبَبْتَ (istašbabta) /is.taʃ.bab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَشَبَّ (istašabba)
# اِسْتَشْبَبْتِ (istašbabti) /is.taʃ.bab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَشَبَّ (istašabba)
# اُسْتُشْبِبْتُ (ustušbibtu) /us.tuʃ.
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
